To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we develop a method to produce salient regions for any differentiable image classification model, that can be used to produce saliency maps and can be used for object detection.

we developed a fast saliety detection method that can applied to any differentable image classifier and can be applied to real time systems, that we trained a masking model to manupulate the scores of the classifer by masking salient part of the input image, and that our model generalises well for unseen images.
we developed a real-time saliency detection algorithm for black box classifiers, which is applicable to all differentiable image classifiers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) How to produce salient image regions for a black box classifier?
developing a saliency detection algorithm for black box classifiers that can be applied in real-time systems and is generalisable to unseen data.
a new saliency metric that can be computed in real time for black box classifiers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose an efficient and general method to produce interpretable saliency maps for any image classifier.
the proposed approach can be used for real-time saliency detection and can be applied to different types of black box classifiers.
the proposed method provides an effective tool for real-time saliency detection and can be applied to differentiable classifiers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a fast and interpretable saliency detection algorithm that can be applied on any differentiable image classifer.
we have a real time image saliency detection algorithm for any classifier.
we develop a fast and accurate saliency method for black box classifiers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a single forward pass through the classifier is enough to produce a saliency map.
a simple masking model can be used to detect image saliency in a real-time manner.
salient regions are often sufficient for classification and that the salient regions can be learned without access to the ground truth labels.
